title: Sulfenylcarbenes and sulfenylnitrenes in organic synthesis
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5CS00278H, Tutorial Review
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Prakash Kafle, Deacon Herndon, Indrajeet Sharma
Sulfenylcarbenes and sulfenylnitrenes are ambiphilic reactive intermediates, enabling cycloadditions, single-atom insertion, and late-stage functionalizations. This review highlights their generation, and applications in modern synthesis.
